exercise.title: Open strings without looking
exercise.why: The pick makes the same trip between the strings every round, so after enough rounds your hand can find the strings while you look away.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome. Pick each open string four times, down, one note per beat.
Follow the tab for one round, then look away and listen. A wrong string sounds too high or too low: let your hand fix it by feel.
